data.name: Arjyak
data.gender_notes: Arjyak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arjyak is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arj’ meaning righteous, and ‘yak’ meaning just or pure. This name is given to a boy signifying that he will be virtuous, honest, and just in his actions. The name Arjyak carries the meaning “Righteous, Just, Pure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arjyak usually hope their child will grow to embody righteous, just, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Arjyak belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Righteous, Just, Pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arjyak total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
